author: DaBeastBrock
body: Hi Avicus. Im writing this to appeal to a ban.I was banned for using Aimbot on February, 16th of 2015. I know it was a very long time ago but i loved the server and i want to get back a chance to play on this server.So Please can i get back on the server to play. I promise never to hack on the server ever again. So please accept and i hope you unban me. Thanks for reading this.
